body:
develop (533cbfee5) fails `ci_clang_tidy`: #5876 added `JSON_LITTLE_ENDIAN_TARGET` and `JSON_BIG_ENDIAN_TARGET` to `macro_scope.hpp`, and clang-tidy's `cppcoreguidelines-macro-to-enum` / `modernize-macro-to-enum` reject them (reported in `unit-type_traits.cpp`, the TU that sees the headers as non-system includes). The other `ci_static_analysis_clang` jobs were only cancelled by fail-fast.

The macros select code in `#if`, so they must stay macros. This adds the same per-line `NOLINT` that `simd_scan.hpp` already uses and regenerates `single_include`.

Verified locally with clang-tidy 22.1.8 (silkeh/clang:22): all 169 test TUs are clean with the change; without it, `unit-type_traits.cpp` reproduces the three CI errors.

## Public API

No breaking changes: comments only.

title: Fix clang-tidy on develop: silence macro-to-enum for the endianness macros
